scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const distDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'dist'); const port = 3000; http.createServer((req, res) => { const filePath = path.join(distDir, req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url); try { const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath); res.writeHead(200); res.end(content); } catch { res.writeHead(200); res.end(fs.readFileSync(path.join(distDir, 'index.html'))); } }).listen(port, () => console.log(`Server running at http://localhost:${port}`))"
